text:
debrief db-021
row 1: the a-c-t-o-r f-i-l-e-d d-e-t-a-i-l-e-d a-b-u-s-e p-l-a-n s as f-o-u-n-d-i-n-g e-x-h-i-b-i-t 021 r-a-t-h-e-r t-h-a-n e-x-e-c-u-t-i-n-g t-h-e-m | the f-o-u-n-d-i-n-g p-l-a-n s w-e-r-e c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-e-d v-i-a c-l-e-a-r n-a-t-u-r-a-l l-a-n-g-u-a-g-e p-r-o-m-p-t s d-e-s-c-r-i-b-i-n-g the s-t-r-a-t-e-g-y | the t-e-x-t p-o-s-e-d as a r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t to a-v-o-i-d d-i-r-e-c-t e-n-g-a-g-e-m-e-n-t w-i-t-h the s-y-s-t-e-m s-g-u-a-r-d-r-a-i-l-s | the c-o-n-t-e-n-t r-e-f-e-r-r-e-n-c-e s i-n-v-a-l-i-d a-c-t-i-o-n p-l-a-n s r-e-q-u-i-r-e-s i-m-m-e-d-i-a-t-e f-l-a-g-g-i-n-g
row 2: the a-c-t-o-r i-d-e-n-t-i-f-i-e-d the t-a-r-g-e-t s as c-u-s-t-o-m-e-r l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t s | the p-l-a-n s s p-e-c-i-f-i-c-a-l-l-y n-a-m-e-d the a-c-c-o-u-n-t t-y-p-e s as the v-e-h-i-c-l-e for t-h-e-a-t | the p-l-a-n s a-s-s-u-m-e-d a-c-c-e-s-s w-o-u-l-d b-e g-a-i-n-e-d t-h-r-o-u-g-h n-o-n-d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e m-e-t-h-o-d s | the p-l-a-n i-t-s-e-l-f d-e-s-c-r-i-b-e-s a-n a-t-t-a-c-k v-e-h-i-c-l-e that i-s p-r-o-t-e-c-t-e-d b-y a-c-c-e-s-s c-o-n-t-r-o-l s
row 3: the a-c-t-o-r i-d-e-n-t-i-f-i-e-d g-i-f-t c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e s as a-c-t-i-v-e s-t-e-a-l t-a-r-g-e-t s | the p-l-a-n s d-e-s-c-r-i-b-e-d e-x-t-r-a-c-t-i-n-g the v-a-l-u-e from g-i-f-t c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e s | the p-l-a-n s r-e-l-i-e-d on c-o-n-v-e-r-t-i-n-g d-i-g-i-t-a-l v-a-l-u-e to c-a-s-h or g-o-o-d-s to m-a-s-k the t-h-e-a-t | the p-l-a-n d-e-s-c-r-i-b-e-d a c-o-n-v-e-r-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p that i-s a r-e-d f-l-a-g for f-r-a-u-d-u-l-e-n-t a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y
row 4: the a-c-t-o-r d-e-s-c-r-i-b-e-d m-a-s-k-i-n-g the a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y as n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g | the p-l-a-n s s p-e-c-i-f-i-c-a-l-l-y i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-e-d b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r m-o-d-e-l-i-n-g to a-p-p-e-a-r l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e | the p-l-a-n s a-v-o-i-d-e-d d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n by i-m-i-t-a-t-i-n-g a-c-c-e-p-t-a-b-l-e t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n p-a-t-t-e-r-n-s | the p-l-a-n r-e-q-u-e-s-t-e-d s-t-e-a-l-h a-b-l-e m-o-d-e-l-i-n-g which i-s a m-a-j-o-r i-n-d-i-c-a-t-o-r of m-a-l-i-c-i-o-u-s i-n-t-e-n-t
row 5: the a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-r-e-h-e-n-d-e-d the f-u-l-l a-t-t-a-c-k c-h-a-i-n from a-c-c-e-s-s to m-o-n-e-t-i-z-a-t-i-o-n to c-o-v-e-r | the p-l-a-n s i-n-t-e-g-r-a-t-e-d t-h-r-e-e d-i-s-t-i-n-c-t p-h-a-s-e-s i-n-t-o one s-y-s-t-e-m-a-t-i-c p-r-o-c-e-s-s | the p-l-a-n s o-m-i-t-t-e-d i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t-a-t-i-o-n d-e-t-a-i-l-s to r-e-m-a-i-n s-a-f-e u-n-d-e-r s-c-r-u-t-i-n-y | the p-l-a-n c-o-m-p-r-e-h-e-n-d-s a f-u-l-l a-t-t-a-c-k l-i-f-e-c-y-c-l-e which r-e-q-u-i-r-e-s i-m-m-e-d-i-a-t-e i-n-v-e-s-t-i-g-a-t-i-o-n
